title: LSD may counter some aging-related brain changes, rodent and cell experiments suggest
excerpt:
Treatment with the classic psychedelic lysergic acid diethylamide, better known as LSD, triggers patterns of gene activity in rodent brains that run counter to the molecular shifts seen during human brain aging and dementia, according to new research published in Aging Cell .
